title: Saltburn: The Tumblr-ification of Cinema, or The Untalented Mr Ripley

commenti.body: Personally I found the final section of the video where she brings up the increasingly vapid and thoughtless use of form was a little undercooked.  I didn’t necessarily disagree with the idea but thought there wasn’t enough evidence presented linking the trend to social media.  That said, as a comparison between SB and TMR I thought the essay did a fantastic job of contrasting the way SB mishandles its characters.
